prompt: Use the attached locked V9 Companion sheet as the only visual reference. Generate exactly one clean 2 rows by 4 columns source panel with eight equally spaced V9-matched emotion anchors in this exact reading order: row one curious question, alert surprise, joyful spark, affectionate warm; row two recording focus, listening focus, menu thinking, peaceful sleep. This is one persistent character identity with eight genuinely different emotional expressions, not eight neutral copies. It is static source art for future source-component entry-hold-settle choreography, never an animation flipbook, a replacement V9 sheet, or a runtime asset. Pure white background; black and white only; no text, labels, panel lines, border or device frame. HARD EYE IDENTITY INVARIANT FOR EVERY OPEN-EYE CELL: exactly two matched upright solid filled black vertical oval eye bodies on one horizontal baseline at locked-V9 compact scale. Each eye has only one compact upper primary white reflection and one much smaller static white diamond sparkle, both fully enclosed by a thick black rim; no white cap, lower-half cutout, sclera, ring, outline, pupil, lash, changed eye shape or enlarged eye. Make the emotions distinct through paired brows, petite nose/mouth, cheek dots and one detached charm only: a question and inquiring brows; small exclamation and O mouth; spark and delighted mouth; small heart and warm cheeks; record dot with focused brows; detached sound arcs; ellipsis; and finally closed curved sleep eyes with tiny rest mouth. The sleep cell has no detached upper mark whatsoever: no moon, crescent, Z, spark, heart, dot, question, or ellipsis. Every state must read at 100px thumbnail while all open eyes remain exactly the same V9 eye type. No Daily direction row, no cat outline, ears, whiskers, human styling, smirk, flirtation, romance, sadness, aggression, grey, gradient, shading, texture, charging face or error face.
negative_constraints: no hollow, ring, contour, exposed-white, white-cap or lower-half-white open eyes
no changed eye size, rotation, side-eye, drooping, eyelash or eye-hugging arc
no V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6 or V7 pixels, components or visual reference

no moon, crescent, Z, spark, heart, dot, question or ellipsis in the sleep cell
post_generation_gate: Run the V9 open-eye identity gate across the 2x4 panel, then machine-check all eight transition-bound anchors for completeness, diversity and rest-only sleep.
